newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.09 up at 42.58 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday amid profit-taking in the U.S. currency after it rose sharply on Tuesday, dealers said.

"Dollar selling by small investors is likely to continue but major players may see current levels attractive to buy dollars," one dealer said. The rupee might fluctuate between 42.55 and 42.65 before the Friday weekend.
The State Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 6.40 percent, same as on Tuesday.
